data.body: Consideration: [Scope] Hook scan path scope must be explicit — code-only (with doc-exempt path list) vs scan-docs-too (with '# stack-case-exempt: documentation' annotation requirement). Skill .md files are executable LLM instructions consumed by agents and reference config values; they are neither pure code nor pure docs. Decide and document the policy in DETECTION-SCHEMA.md anti-pattern section so S11 doc updates do not trip false positives.
